record.title: China issues a recommended technical standard for large-model inference platforms
record.summary: China's national standards catalogue records YD/T 7171—2026 as a recommended communications industry standard for large-model inference platforms, published on 2026-07-15 and effective from 2026-11-01. Its stated scope covers model compression, deployment, inference, platform services and management and provides functional reference for institutions using such platforms. The catalogue does not establish mandatory adoption, organization-level compliance or measured implementation outcomes.
organizations: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People's Republic of China
National Standards Information Public Service Platform

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: China's national standards catalogue records YD/T 7171—2026, Artificial Intelligence—Key Basic Technology—Large Model Inference Platform Technical Requirements, as a recommended communications industry standard published 2026-07-15 and currently in effect as of 2026-11-01, with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology as主管 department.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: The catalogue says the standard covers technical capabilities in model compression, deployment, inference, platform services and management, and provides functional reference for institutions deploying, inferring with and serving large models on such platforms.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: The catalogue record does not establish mandatory adoption, organization-level compliance, changes to deployed systems, measured inference performance, cost reductions or market-wide implementation effects.

evidence_gaps.description: The catalogue confirms the standard metadata and scope but the full standard text was not inspected, so detailed normative clauses and conformance criteria are not assessed.
No organization-level implementation, compliance, performance or economic outcome evidence was inspected.

brief.importance_rationale: A current technical reference for Chinese large-model inference platform design and procurement may affect local engineering choices across compression, deployment, inference and serving. The catalogue marks it recommended; the record does not show mandatory adoption or realized performance/economic effects.
limitations: The national standards catalogue labels YD/T 7171—2026 a recommended communications industry standard; this record does not call it a mandatory legal requirement.
Only the catalogue metadata and summary scope were inspected; the full standard text and detailed conformance tests were not reviewed.
No organization-level adoption, compliance, performance, cost or market outcome was measured.
